classification.basis: The custom guest registered VMBus, Hyper-V VSOCK and hv_storvsc, attached both virtual disks, and mounted the system-distro ext4 filesystem. Unlike K-STORAGE-001, mini_init did not segfault or panic after that mount. Source ordering and subsequent system-distro startup messages show that overlay construction returned successfully. Stable control messaging was not established because the excluded guest networking service closed its GNS socket, so B4 is not proved.

terminalObservedFailure.hostError: Expected message LxGnsMessageResult, but socket GNS was closed
hostSequence: Mirrored networking was rejected and fell back to NAT.
The host fell back to networkingMode None.
A later LX_MINI_INIT_CONFIG_MESSAGE send failed with 0x80072746 because the guest channel had closed.
guestSequence: mini_init completed the system-distro ext4 mount without the prior segfault.
The host closed the failed startup path.
Guest cleanup detached disks and powered down without a kernel panic.

secondaryObservations: The cgroup mount, missing hvc console, page-reporting parameter, and missing PTP clock remained non-terminal.
The /proc/self/task/1/children ReadFile error occurred in mini_init ErrorExit cleanup after the host-side GNS failure. CONFIG_PROC_CHILDREN is not selected from this evidence.
The host's kernel-version warning is a misleading consequence of the reduced capability report; the captured guest kernel identifies itself as Linux 6.18.40.1+.
No custom-guest segfault, panic, or crash dump was observed.
decision: Overlayfs removed the K-STORAGE-001 crash and exposed stock GNS networking as the next stable blocker. Networking is explicitly outside Minimal Viable WSL, so stop additive stock-init kernel discovery here. Do not add HYPERV_NET, networking, seccomp, cgroups, PTP, PROC_CHILDREN, page reporting, or console features from this trial. Pivot to the reduced host-and-guest control plane: prevent the host from awaiting GNS or advertising the system distro, remove the guest networking path, and preserve only VSOCK, registered-distro VHDX/ext4, root transition, command relay, exit status, and termination.
